archive_runtime_checks: scripts/release/smoke_archive.py: verify_artifacts, version --bundled, smoke_static ML/redaction/legacy rejection, selftest --ml

checks_per_platform: scan . --ml --format json on a mounted two-line AWS fixture under --network none: aws_access_key_id + aws_secret_access_key, truncated=false
docker_image.note: Release workflow passes VERSION=${github.ref_name}, so the image reports a v-prefixed version while archives do not; identical to refs/tags/v1.4.0 release.yml and kept as-is.

not_covered: Windows amd64/arm64 runtime (requires hosted windows-latest job in ci.yml)
hosted GitHub Actions run of ci.yml/release.yml
cosign signing, SBOM attestation and GHCR push
publication of the final v1.5.0 tag, release and Homebrew formula
